correctness.rationale: For invariant probability compactly supported by Koper flow, antiderivative generator tests in x and z give E[y|x]=x^3−3x and E[y|z]=z−lambda. Since residuals equal epsilon xdot and zdot/delta, Pythagorean conditional orthogonality gives both exact variance deficiencies. Differentiate ydot=kx−2(y+lambda)+z and eliminate z to obtain yddot+(2+delta) ydot+delta y=k xdot+delta k x−delta lambda. Stationary multiplication by ydot, plus derivatives of xdot²/2 and xy, yields k E[(3x²−3−delta epsilon)xdot²]=(2+delta)E[ydot²]. Vanishing squared speed of any coordinate on compact complete support forces an equilibrium; the ydot=0 case reduces to xdot=−delta x+delta(y+lambda)/k, unbounded backward except constant. For k<0, non-equilibrium support must put positive mass where |x|<sqrt(1+delta epsilon/3). Independent algebra also checked via packaged exact sparse polynomial code. The strip is necessary not sufficient and is a strict enlargement of fold strip |x|<1.
